rule: init.md §1 rule 19 — every source has an expiring rights and budget go/no-go before Production use
provider: Zhipu AI — GLM coding plan (open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4; api.z.ai mirror)
verification: chat.completions HTTP 200 with thinking disabled and JSON output; the AEP two-candidate case selected 17,581 (subsidiaries-wide) over 6,994 (service company) with a correct reason; 305 tokens, 1.9 s
use: selection among enumerated candidate spans for prose-only standards (employees_total first; segment revenue and supply-chain relationships later) — never free-form extraction from a whole filing, never a consumer-facing surface

rights.raw_retention: request and response bodies stored in staging.model_invocations (append-only) as the evidence of each decision
rights.derived_metric: the chosen value lands as a fact with the model extractor id and the invocation id on its evidence_ref
rights.publication: published numbers carry confidence 0.90 (policy headcount-confidence:v1, entry model-selection) and the three §8 status dimensions once #747 lands
rights.quotation_attribution: not applicable — the evidence quoted is the issuer's own filing text, not the provider's output
rights.note: the coding plan is sold for coding assistants; the owner accepts this use under the plan's terms or moves to the metered general endpoint (which returned 429 'insufficient balance' on 2026-09-07)

budget.capacity_declared: gateway seat filing-extraction-model: 30 calls / 60 s window, 2000 calls / day (placeholder until the plan's published limits are recorded here)
budget.expected_load: ≈ 20 calls per weekly backfill today (17 deferred filings + new listings); ≈ 300 tokens each
budget.cost_field: staging.api_call_ledger.cost = total tokens per call; staging.model_invocations.cost the same

credential.never: in code, fixtures, logs or issue text

approval.status: PENDING — this record is the go/no-go the owner signs by merging the PR that adds it; unsigned, the loop keeps every multi-candidate filing as needs_model_selection

routing_note: 2026-09-07: /models lists glm-4.5 … glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash; the plan routes legacy names to current models (requests for glm-4.7/4.6/5-turbo answered by glm-5.3-flash, glm-5/5.1 by glm-5.3). All 16 production invocations that asked for glm-4.7 were served by glm-5.3-flash. Replaying those 16 requests against explicit glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash reproduced every recorded decision (16/16, 5,663 prompt tokens each). The seat now requests glm-5.3 explicitly and records response.model as served_model.
